caption: Sint-Ludovicuskerk, Rincon
composition: White church and later bell tower among low houses, dark hills behind · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Ludovicuskerk is the white church in the middle of Rincon, with the bell tower added in the late-1970s works, and low houses around it. It is clear, about 28.4°C, with wind near 22.5 km/h and cloud cover about 12%. The scenario uses America/Kralendijk. No sign is readable. The waterfront and the salt pans are other places.
